title: [Feature Request] Configurable Timeout for Hooks
body:
Recently, #712 Hooks were added to Claude Code.

Hooks currently come with a default timeout of 60 seconds, which cannot be configured.

As we have some validations that can occasionally take longer than 60 seconds to run (e.g. System / E2E tests), this limitation makes hooks less useful than they could be.

It'd be great if the default timeout of hooks could be:
- Customized per hook
- Changed globally

Either or would neatly solve the issue for us.

Thanks a ton for this great feature! <3
author: PM-CS
